title: 第23章 嗨新的未婚夫认识一下查看更多章节...
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
“统公公有何良计，但说无妨。”昭杺柠心声询问。
系统开始献计：
【此处是九尾狐族的星辰境，里面森林肯定有很多危险】
【待会儿我给你指路，你将蓝莘带入陷阱中，就能甩开她了】
“呵呵，你这果然是奸计。”昭杺柠冷笑：“系统，收手吧，你现在对蓝莘的针对根本藏不住。”
【那是你自己说的要甩开蓝莘啊，我才给你出主意的】
又被怼了，系统也有点破防。
“先导航涂辞珩的位置吧。”昭杺柠叹了一口气。
至于如何中途甩开蓝莘的跟随，她得靠自己临场发挥了。
【宿主，已成功导航涂辞珩的坐标，总路程7公里】
“蓝莘，你会御剑带人吗？”听见系统给出的路程，昭杺柠期待地询问。
“我当然会啦。”蓝莘热情回答，又疑惑地低声：“魔后，你不会御剑吗？”
“不对不对。”蓝莘刚问完就自己打消自己的疑惑，对昭杺柠竖起大拇指：“不愧是魔后，伪装都这么全面。”
如今伪装成凡人，就连凡人不可能御剑飞行这点都考虑到了。
“细节啊。”蓝莘还在对昭杺柠夸赞。
昭杺柠微扬下巴，泰然接受赞美，还提点着：“想要欺骗人，最先需要将自己骗过去。”
“懂了。”蓝莘恍然大悟，连忙掏出本子又开始记。
记完以后，她才召出长剑，御剑带着昭杺柠。
昭杺柠站在蓝莘身后，双手环抱着她的腰，就听蓝莘在前询问：“杺柠，我们往哪飞啊？”
“往东边方向。”昭杺柠根据系统提醒指引。

七公里的路程，在御剑飞行下根本不算远。
昭杺柠就看着系统导航，提示她距离涂辞珩越来越近。
“杺柠，下面有座城。”蓝莘震惊出声：“居然是归云城。”
“归云城出现在星辰境里面了吗？”昭杺柠也偏着脑袋向下看去。
“应该是星辰境复制了归云城的一切。”蓝莘笃定开口。
此刻的归云城热闹繁华，城中百姓都沉浸在美好生活中。
“这位道友，你可知自己现在在哪里。”蓝莘御剑下来，随手拦住一个路人。
路人指着城门大字：“归云城啊，这么大三个字你不认识啊？”
“你就没感觉周围有什么奇怪的吗？”蓝莘又问。
这一次路人认真点头，严肃道：“奇怪的事啊，有。”
“你发现什么奇怪的？”蓝莘期待询问。
就见路人指着她，道：“我看你挺奇怪的。”
“我认真问你呢。”蓝莘一气，正要找路人理论，路人已经挥挥手走远。
“果然有问题，他们不知道自己已经不在星灵大陆了吗。”蓝莘看向昭杺柠。
昭杺柠盯着城门上“归云城”三个大字，道：“我们先进城看看情况吧，而且我们是主动进来的，他们是被动进来的，或许意识被控制了也说不一定。”
“所以他们才不知道自己不在星灵大陆，估计还以为自己就在归云城呢。”
“还是杺柠有见解。”蓝莘又开始无脑夸了。
两人结伴进入归云城，沿途两边是热闹的商街。
content_en:
"Eunuch Tong, what good plan do you have? It's okay to say it." Zhao Hao Ning asked in her heart.
The system starts to offer suggestions:
[This is the star realm of the Nine-tailed Fox Clan, and there must be many dangers in the forest inside]
[I will show you the way later. If you lead Lan Xin into the trap, you can get rid of her]
"Haha, this is indeed a treacherous plot of yours." Zhao Hao Ning sneered: "System, stop it, you can't hide your intentions towards Lan Xin now."
[It was you who said you wanted to get rid of Lan Xin, so I gave you some advice]
I was attacked again, and the system was a bit broken.
"Let's navigate to Tu Ciheng's location first." Zhao Hao Ning sighed.
As for how to get rid of Lan Xin's follower midway, she had to rely on her own improvisation.
[Host, Tu Ciheng’s coordinates have been successfully navigated, the total distance is 7 kilometers]
"Lan Xin, can you lead people with a sword?" Zhao Hao Ning asked expectantly after hearing the distance given by the system.
"Of course I can." Lan Xin replied enthusiastically, then whispered doubtfully: "Queen, don't you know how to wield a sword?"
"No, no." As soon as Lan Xin asked, she dismissed her doubts and gave Zhao Hao Ning a thumbs up: "As expected of the Queen, she is so comprehensive in her disguise."
Now that he is pretending to be a mortal, he has even considered the fact that it is impossible for a mortal to fly with a sword.
"Details." Lan Xin was still praising Zhao Hao Ning.
Zhao Hao Ning raised her chin slightly and accepted the compliment calmly, adding: "If you want to deceive others, you first need to deceive yourself."
"I understand." Lan Xin suddenly realized it and quickly took out her notebook and started writing again.
After she finished memorizing it, she summoned the long sword and took Zhao Hao Ning with her.
Zhao Hao Ning stood behind Lan Xin, holding her waist with both hands, and heard Lan Xin ask in front of her: "Hao Ning, where are we flying to?"
"Go east." Zhao Hao Ning followed the system prompts.
The distance of seven kilometers is not far at all when flying with the sword.
Zhao Haining looked at the system navigation, which reminded her that she was getting closer to Tu Ciheng.
"Hu Ning, there is a city below." Lan Xin said in shock: "It's actually Guiyun City."
"Has Guiyun City appeared in the Star Realm?" Zhao Hao Ning also tilted his head and looked down.
"It should be that the Star Realm copied everything in Guiyun City." Lan Xin said firmly.
At this moment, Guiyun City is bustling and bustling, and the people in the city are immersed in a beautiful life.
"Fellow Taoist, do you know where you are now?" Lan Xin came down with her sword and stopped a passerby.
A passerby pointed to the big characters on the city gate: "Guiyun City, don't you recognize these three big characters?"
"Don't you feel anything strange around you?" Lan Xin asked again.
This time the passerby nodded seriously and said seriously: "There is something strange, yes."
"What did you find strange?" Lan Xin asked expectantly.
A passerby pointed at her and said, "I think you're quite strange."
"I'm asking you seriously." Lan Xin was angry and was about to argue with a passerby, but the passerby had already waved and walked away.
"Sure enough, there is a problem. Don't they know that they are no longer in the Star Spirit Continent?" Lan Xin looked at Zhao Hao Ning.
Zhao Hao Ning stared at the three characters "Guiyun City" on the city gate and said, "Let's go into the city first to see the situation. Moreover, we came in proactively, and they came in passively. Maybe their consciousness was controlled."
"That's why they don't know that they are not in the Star Spirit Continent. They probably think that they are in Guiyun City."
"Mo Ning still has some insights." Lan Xin started to boast again.
The two of them entered Guiyun City together, and there were busy shopping streets on both sides of the road.
